securityPolicy.heading: Security policy
securityPolicy.subtitle: The rules this panel enforces for every account on it.
securityPolicy.forceTwoFactorWarning: Turn this on only once you can complete enrolment. An administrator without a second factor is held on the enrolment screen and can reach nothing else, so an account that cannot enrol is locked out until someone with access to the server intervenes.
securityPolicy.maxFailedLoginAttemptsLabel: Failed sign-ins before an account locks
securityPolicy.lockoutMinutesLabel: How long an account stays locked, in minutes
